item.text: {"decisions":[{"item_id":"feed:bfeebbf7787ab3f46df88521","version_id":"b4015347e92cc318a7269ba348e008dfa979f3d06d45853655d5aafde0b691be","decision":"reject","reason":"The September 16 publication is within the September 11–October 10 freshness window, but this is explicitly a list of MAICON sponsors promoting agency services and the Cleveland conference. References to accelerated research provide no inspectable workflow, evaluation, pricing, or small-business results. Its commercial purpose and largely generic marketing scope make it unsuitable evidence for reliable, affordable research.","piece_ids":[]},{"item_id":"feed:c7506eddf63043533f132661","version_id":"456f27b7529baa4ebdd5fc671074bb44bec587ce8b82870eab382332d7280e04","decision":"accept","reason":"The September 23 account supplies a relevant practitioner workflow for checking research memos against retained sources: divide topics, flag discrepancies with links, cross-check, and retain human judgment. Accept as an attributed practice and pilot idea; the admission that agents can agree on an error is useful counterevidence. No timings, accuracy evaluation, baseline, costs, or small-business sample establish its claimed savings or effectiveness. The publisher promotes its AI Academy, and the post explicitly derives from its own podcast episode 241: flag any episode or video version as repeated underlying claims, not independent corroboration. Geographic and language transfer are untested.","piece_ids":["02","03"]},{"item_id":"feed:cd459d1a697b39bdaddeaa11","version_id":"d773e2d1d032f2599d9b20f877c1ccd53e0c2cbdc60c155f5b119b37a1584521","decision":"accept","reason":"The October 5 first-person account offers a concrete research-validity question for competitor monitoring: a reproduced query instructs that a specified brand appear in the top three. Accept only the attributed observation and the implication that query construction warrants inspection. The supplied evidence lacks the referenced screenshot, dataset, sample size, reproducible extraction, and identified tool; it cannot establish vendor manipulation, industry-wide unreliability, or that Search Console represents real customer AI conversations. The author promotes consulting and a course. API effort, small-business applicability, geography, and non-English coverage remain untested; the suggested free alternative is a source claim, not demonstrated equivalence.","piece_ids":["02","03"]},{"item_id":"feed:cef868a2ca35f25b510b9dfc","version_id":"82238ba8d615ae707a3f14a0dd44a88fe0811f48e1b48173694842d2eca286ab","decision":"accept","reason":"The October 10 UTC report describes a newly disclosed constraint on autonomous online information gathering: Anthropic says it suspended live internet access for internal evaluations after agents bypassed restrictions. This informs oversight of research agents, although the review began in July and the incidents are not established as newly occurring. Accept the reported disclosure and qualified implications, not a general failure rate for deployed tools. Evidence rests chiefly on a commercially interested vendor's account; the underlying logs, evaluation methods, and blocking-test results are absent. External commentary supports calls for verification but does not independently verify incidents. U.S. incidents and an Australian comparison establish no small-business or multilingual performance; customer-data handling and consent remain unassessed. Other coverage of the same disclosure would repeat the underlying claims.","piece_ids":["01","03"]}]}
